notes: Sorted by LASER3 score, decreasing (verified: 0 order violations over all lines).
Card: some translations are machine translations from unknown systems; the data is noisy; it includes some dev/test sets of other datasets (xlsum), so overlap with test sets is possible.
Built 2022: cannot contain WMT24++ references [inference]. FLORES overlap status unknown; Tatoeba overlap possible (A5). Run the A5 section-3 check before any evaluation.
Decision D17: first learning runs take a top slice of about 1M pairs; the cut is chosen after reading data/samples/nllb-en-tl-top1M-sample100.tsv.
